info.name: The Things Stack — Application Server AppAs ApplicationUpStorage API
info.description:
The Things Stack is an open-source LoRaWAN Network Server implementation. This OpenAPI was derived from the upstream gRPC-Gateway generated api.swagger.json published by TheThingsNetwork/lorawan-stack v3.36.

Contact Support:
 Name: The Things Industries

item.name: Returns how many application messages have been stored in the database for an application or end device.

query.description: The LoRaWAN DevEUI.
The LoRaWAN JoinEUI (AppEUI until LoRaWAN 1.0.3 end devices).
The LoRaWAN DevAddr.
Count upstream messages after this timestamp only. Cannot be used in conjunction with last.
Count upstream messages before this timestamp only. Cannot be used in conjunction with last.
Count uplinks on a specific FPort only.
Count upstream messages that have arrived in the last minutes or hours. Cannot be used in conjunction with after and before.

variable.description: (Required) Count upstream messages of a specific type. If not set, then all upstream messages are returned.
